review_notes: The chapter's ketiv/qere unit WLC.PRO.11.3.v001 is underdetermined and its fallback remains among the readings the English permits, so rule 53 does not apply.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV PRO.11.3 renders the clause 'But the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them', which fits either witness equally: qere ישדם and ketiv ושדם are the same verb (שדד) with the same 3mp suffix, differing only in the prefixed letter, and both yield 'shall destroy them'. The initial 'But' is the ASV's usual English marking of antithetical parallelism in Proverbs, not a rendering of a waw, so it cannot be read as evidence for the ketiv's prefixed waw. No ASV note is mapped to this unit and no italicized supply bears on it, so nothing in the English distinguishes the readings; both remain compatible and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
